name: libp2p_mix_rln_module
description: Logos mixnet node: libp2p transport, Sphinx-based mix routing, RLN per-hop rate limiting. Implements LIP LOGOS-MIXNET.
author: Logos Core Team

config.description: JSON config — inline, or a path to a JSON file — overlaid onto the default options when the module is loaded. Every key is optional. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET fixes several protocol parameters (path length, Sphinx sizes, cover-traffic strategy); those are not configurable. Parameters marked TBD in LIP LOGOS-MIXNET are exposed here with placeholder defaults that MUST be pinned before mainnet use.

schema.bootstrapNodes: array<{ peerId: string, addrs: array<multiaddr string> }> — libp2p bootstrap peers used to seed mix-node discovery
schema.privKey: string — hex-encoded libp2p host private key. Omit to generate on start.

mix.mixPrivKey: string — hex-encoded X25519 private key advertised for Sphinx path selection. Omit to generate on start.

cover.rateFraction: float — CONSTANT_RATE cover-traffic ratio. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET default: 0.7.

rln.keystorePath: string — path to the RLN keystore file
rln.keystorePassword: string — password for the RLN keystore
rln.treePath: string — path to the persisted Merkle tree
rln.rlnResourcesPath: string — path to zerokit precomputed resources (verification key, circom .zkey)
rln.rlnIdentifier: string — hex-encoded RLN identifier for this Logos mixnet deployment
rln.epochDurationSeconds: int — RLN epoch length. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET: TBD; placeholder default 1.
rln.period: int — messaging period. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET: TBD; placeholder default 1.
rln.messagingRate: int — allowed messages per period. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET: TBD; placeholder default 10.
rln.maxEpochGap: int — accepted epoch drift. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET: TBD; placeholder default 20.
rln.userMessageLimit: int — per-user message cap per epoch. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET: TBD; placeholder default 100.
rln.acceptableRootWindowSize: int — Merkle-root history window. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET: 5.
rln.stakedFund: string — required stake to register. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET: TBD.
rln.membershipContentTopic: string — RLN Relay content topic for membership. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET: TBD; placeholder "/mix/rln/membership/v1".
rln.proofMetadataContentTopic: string — RLN Relay content topic for proof metadata. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET: TBD; placeholder "/mix/rln/metadata/v1".
rln.coordCluster: int — RLN Relay cluster id. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET: TBD; placeholder 0.

discovery.serviceId: string — service id advertised by mix-capable nodes. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET: TBD; placeholder "logos.mixnet".
